answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. A harbor of per-task receipts records who did what, and the haven of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. By the dawn of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on invitation quota tree, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks.
